title: Original geographic native archive binding and completed-course handover

files.content:
"""Bind the existing geographic receiving archive to its original saved science.

The maintained portable writer/reader owns serialization and restoration.
This helper adds the selected original records and artifact identities; it never
prepares inputs, runs models, renders a report, or changes a received Workspace.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import zipfile

from model.common import atomic_json, digest, identifier, read_json
from model import portable, reviews


def _require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def retained_prepared(workspace, output, selection_bytes, normalized_selection):
    """Resume a completed preparation under the original admitted operation."""
    output = Path(output)
    original = read_json(output / "admission.json")
    state = read_json(output / "receiving.json")
    prepared = read_json(output / "prepared.json")
    original_bytes = (output / "original-selection.json").read_bytes()
    operation = original.get("id")
    _require(operation == digest({k: v for k, v in original.items() if k != "id"}),
             "Original geographic admission identity changed")
    _require(state.get("operation_id") == operation
             and state.get("project_id") == workspace.project["id"]
             and original.get("project_id") == workspace.project["id"],
             "Resume the original geographic operation and Workspace")
    _require(original_bytes == selection_bytes
             and hashlib.sha256(original_bytes).hexdigest() == original.get("selection_bytes_sha256")
             and original.get("selection") == normalized_selection,
             "Resume the original complete geographic selection")
    _require(prepared == state.get("prepared")
             and prepared.get("selection") == normalized_selection
             and prepared.get("project_id") == workspace.project["id"]
             and prepared.get("id") == state.get("geographic_edition_id")
             and prepared.get("ensemble_id") == state.get("ensemble_id"),
             "Retained preparation differs from its admitted geographic operation")
    relative = portable.member_name(prepared["directory"])
    original_prepared = read_json(workspace.root.joinpath(*relative.parts) / "prepared.json")
    _require(original_prepared == prepared, "Original Workspace geographic preparation changed")
    plan = workspace._get("ensembles", prepared["ensemble_id"])
    run_ids = {item["run_id"] for member in plan["members"] for item in member["runs"]}
    _require(run_ids and all(workspace.inspect_run(key)["state"] == "complete" for key in run_ids),
             "Adopt report-only handover after all original native runs complete")
    return original, state, prepared


def _archive_selection(requested, handover):
    requested = ({"include_intermediates": True, "include_deliveries": True}
                 if requested is None else dict(requested))
    _require(set(requested) == {"include_intermediates", "include_deliveries"}
             and all(type(value) is bool for value in requested.values()),
             "Bind the exact requested native archive policy")
    if handover is not None:
        requested.update(delivery_id=identifier(handover["id"]), include_delivery_assets=True)
    return requested


def binding(workspace, prepared, scientific, delivery, review, response_id, *,
            archive_selection=None, handover=None, utility_context=None):
    """Describe the exact original selection required in a complete archive."""
    members = {}
    cache = {}
    source_ids = set()
    root = workspace.root.resolve()

    def add(relative, expected):
        relative = portable.member_name(relative).as_posix()
        item = {"bytes": expected["bytes"], "sha256": expected["sha256"]}
        identifier(item["sha256"])
        _require(type(item["bytes"]) is int and item["bytes"] >= 0,
                 "Original archive member length is invalid")
        key = "workspace/" + relative
        _require(key not in members or members[key] == item,
                 "Selected original member has conflicting identities: " + relative)
        members[key] = item

    def record(relative, expected=None):
        member = portable.member_name(relative)
        path = root.joinpath(*member.parts)
        _require(not path.is_symlink() and path.resolve(strict=True).is_relative_to(root),
                 "Selected original record escapes its Workspace")
        _require(stat.S_ISREG(path.stat().st_mode), "Select an original regular record")
        body = path.read_bytes()
        value = json.loads(body)
        _require(expected is None or value == expected,
                 "Selected original record changed: " + relative)
        add(relative, {"bytes": len(body), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()})
        return value

    def immutable(kind, key):
        key = identifier(key)
        value = workspace._get(kind, key)
        record(kind + "/" + key + ".json", {k: v for k, v in value.items() if k != "id"})
        return value

    def descriptor(directory, item):
        path = portable.member_name(item["path"])
        add((Path(directory) / Path(*path.parts)).as_posix(), item)

    def collection(key):
        key = identifier(key)
        if key in source_ids:
            return
        value = immutable("sources", key)
        source_ids.add(key)
        cache[("sources", key)] = value
        for entry in value["entries"]:
            cache[(key, entry["id"])] = entry
        bodies = [value["original_manifest"]]
        for entry in value["entries"]:
            bodies.extend([entry["body"], *entry["companions"]])
        for body in bodies:
            add(body["object"], body)

    _require(prepared["project_id"] == workspace.project["id"]
             and scientific.get("workspace_id") == workspace.project["id"]
             and scientific.get("ensemble_id") == prepared["ensemble_id"]
             and scientific.get("state") == "complete",
             "Select the completed original geographic scientific report")
    record("workspace.json", workspace.project)
    geo_directory = portable.member_name(prepared["directory"]).as_posix()
    _require(geo_directory == "geographic-headwaters/" + identifier(prepared["id"]),
             "Selected preparation has another geographic directory")
    record(geo_directory + "/prepared.json", prepared)
    input_receipt = record(geo_directory + "/inputs/input-receipt.json")
    _require(input_receipt.get("identity", {}).get("id") == prepared["id"],
             "Original geographic input receipt belongs to another edition")
    omitted_runtime_members = []
    for item in input_receipt["files"]:
        # WAT retains its held .prepare.lock in the original input directory.
        # The full portable writer intentionally omits locks; the unchanged
        # input receipt still records that original zero-content runtime file.
        if portable.member_name(item["path"]).name.endswith(".lock"):
            omitted_runtime_members.append(geo_directory + "/inputs/" + item["path"])
            continue
        descriptor(geo_directory + "/inputs", item)

    plan = immutable("ensembles", prepared["ensemble_id"])
    run_ids = sorted({item["run_id"] for member in plan["members"] for item in member["runs"]})
    selected_runs = [prepared["baseline_run_id"], *prepared["alternative_run_ids"]]
    selected_scenarios = [prepared["baseline_scenario_id"], *prepared["alternative_scenario_ids"]]
    _require(len(selected_runs) == len(set(selected_runs))
             and len(selected_runs) == len(selected_scenarios)
             and set(selected_runs).issubset(run_ids),
             "Selected geographic baseline and alternatives differ from the original ensemble")
    grids = {}
    profiles = {}
    scenarios = {}
    for run_id in run_ids:
        run = workspace.inspect_run(run_id)
        _require(run["id"] == run_id and run["state"] == "complete",
                 "Finish every selected original native run before complete handover")
        record("runs/" + run_id + "/run.json", run)
        for item in run["artifacts"].values():
            descriptor("runs/" + run_id, item)
        selected = run["selection"]
        if run_id in selected_runs:
            index = selected_runs.index(run_id)
            _require(selected["grid_id"] == prepared["grid_id"]
                     and selected["profile_id"] == prepared["profile_id"]
                     and selected["scenario_id"] == selected_scenarios[index],
                     "Original geographic run changed its selected grid, profile or scenario")
        grids[selected["grid_id"]] = workspace.get_grid(selected["grid_id"])
        profiles[selected["profile_id"]] = immutable("profiles", selected["profile_id"])
        scenarios[selected["scenario_id"]] = immutable("scenarios", selected["scenario_id"])
    for grid_id, grid in grids.items():
        record("grids/" + grid_id + "/grid.json", grid)
        for item in grid["files"].values():
            descriptor("grids/" + grid_id, item)
        collection(grid["spec"]["source_collection_id"])
    for value in [*profiles.values(), *scenarios.values()]:
        collection(value["source_collection_id"])
    collection(prepared["source_collection_id"])
    collection(scientific["source"]["source_collection_id"])

    scientific_id = identifier(scientific["id"])
    operation = record("ensemble-study-sources/" + scientific_id + "/operation.json",
                       {k: v for k, v in scientific.items() if k != "source_state"})
    for item in operation["files"].values():
        descriptor("", item)
    delivery_id = identifier(delivery["id"])
    saved_delivery = record("deliveries/" + delivery_id + "/delivery-state.json")
    _require(saved_delivery.get("id") == delivery_id
             and saved_delivery.get("state") == "complete"
             and saved_delivery.get("selection", {}).get("baseline_run_id") == prepared["baseline_run_id"]
             and saved_delivery.get("selection", {}).get("scenario_run_ids") == prepared["alternative_run_ids"],
             "Selected geographic delivery changed its original model cohort")

    utility_id = None
    utility_sources = set()
    if utility_context is not None:
        from model import geographic_receiving_context as utilities
        from model import receiving_waters as waters, receiving_water_report_source as reports
        utility_id = identifier(utility_context["id"])
        original_context = utilities.inspect(workspace, utility_id)
        _require(original_context == utility_context
                 and original_context["prepared_id"] == prepared["id"]
                 and original_context["baseline_run_id"] == prepared["baseline_run_id"]
                 and original_context["alternative_run_ids"] == prepared["alternative_run_ids"],
                 "Retain the utility context of the selected geographic native cohort")
        context_directory = "geographic-receiving-contexts/" + utility_id
        record(context_directory + "/context.json", original_context)
        record(context_directory + "/selection.json", original_context["identity"])
        # The declared source selectors include contextual original intake
        # entries as well as the geometry/report source collections.
        def context_sources(value):
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                if "source_collection_id" in value:
                    collection(value["source_collection_id"])
                for item in value.values():
                    context_sources(item)
            elif isinstance(value, list):
                for item in value:
                    context_sources(item)
        context_sources(original_context["identity"]["plan_selections"])
        for plan_id in original_context["plan_ids"].values():
            original_plan = waters.inspect_plan(workspace, plan_id)
            directory = "receiving-water-plans/" + identifier(plan_id)
            record(directory + "/plan.json", original_plan)
            for item in original_plan["files"].values():
                descriptor(directory, item)
        for item in original_context["analyses"]:
            analysis_id = identifier(item["analysis_id"])
            analysis = waters.inspect(workspace, analysis_id, verify=True)
            directory = "receiving-water-analyses/" + analysis_id
            record(directory + "/analysis.json", analysis)
            for artifact in analysis["files"].values():
                descriptor(directory, artifact)
            report_id = identifier(item["report_source_id"])
            report = reports.inspect(workspace, report_id, verify=True)
            record("receiving-water-report-sources/" + report_id + "/report.json", report)
            for artifact in report["files"]:
                descriptor("", artifact)
            collection(item["source"]["source_collection_id"])
        utility_sources.update(utilities.source_collection_ids(original_context))

    archive_delivery = None
    if handover is not None:
        handover_id = identifier(handover["id"])
        _require(handover.get("project_id") == workspace.project["id"]
                 and handover_id == digest(handover["identity"]),
                 "Retain the original geographic handover identity")
        directory = Path(handover["directory"]).resolve(strict=True)
        _require(directory.name == handover_id,
                 "Use the handover's original immutable directory")
        handover_record = read_json(directory / "handover-record.json")
        handover_complete = read_json(directory / "handover-complete.json")
        _require(handover_record.get("prepared") == prepared
                 and handover_record.get("scientific", {}).get("id") == scientific_id
                 and handover_record.get("delivery_id") == delivery_id
                 and handover_record.get("review", {}).get("review_id") == review["id"]
                 and handover_record.get("review", {}).get("latest_response_id") == response_id
                 and digest(handover_record) == handover["identity"]["content_sha256"]
                 and handover_complete.get("id") == handover_id
                 and handover_complete.get("identity") == handover["identity"],
                 "Opening page belongs to another geographic scientific/review edition")
        _inputs, delivery_members, archive_delivery = portable._delivery_inputs(
            directory, handover["files"])
        _require(archive_delivery["id"] == handover_id
                 and archive_delivery["files"].get("opening_page", {}).get("path")
                     == "delivery/START_HERE.html",
                 "Retain the native geographic opening page")
        for name, item in delivery_members.items():
            members[name] = item

    retained_review = immutable("reviews", review["id"])
    _require(retained_review == review, "Selected original review changed")
    selected = retained_review["selection"]
    _require(delivery_id in selected["delivery_ids"]
             and set(selected_runs).issubset(selected["run_ids"])
             and {prepared["source_collection_id"], scientific["source"]["source_collection_id"]}
                 .union(utility_sources).issubset(selected["source_collection_ids"]),
             "Selected review omits the original geographic science")
    for key in selected["source_collection_ids"]:
        collection(key)
    responses = reviews.response_prefix(reviews.history(workspace, review["id"]),
                                        through_response_id=response_id)
    for response in responses:
        immutable("review-responses", response["id"])
    for artifact in retained_review["artifacts"]:
        path = reviews._resolve(workspace, artifact, cache).resolve(strict=True)
        _require(path.is_relative_to(root), "Original review artifact escapes its Workspace")
        add(path.relative_to(root).as_posix(), artifact)
    value = {
        "schema": "upstate.geographic-handover-binding/v1",
        "project": workspace.project,
        "archive_selection": _archive_selection(archive_selection, handover),
        "archive_delivery": archive_delivery,
        "handover_id": handover["id"] if handover is not None else None,
        "utility_context_id": utility_id,
        "geographic_edition_id": prepared["id"], "ensemble_id": prepared["ensemble_id"],
        "baseline_run_id": prepared["baseline_run_id"],
        "alternative_run_ids": prepared["alternative_run_ids"], "run_ids": run_ids,
        "grid_ids": sorted(grids), "profile_ids": sorted(profiles),
        "scenario_ids": sorted(scenarios), "source_collection_ids": sorted(source_ids),
        "scientific_source_id": scientific_id, "delivery_id": delivery_id,
        "review_id": review["id"], "review_response_id": response_id,
        "review_response_ids": [row["id"] for row in responses],
        "omitted_runtime_locks": sorted(omitted_runtime_members),
        "members": dict(sorted(members.items())),
    }
    return {"id": digest(value), **value}



def retain_binding(workspace, output, prepared, scientific, delivery, review, response_id, *,
                   archive_selection=None, handover=None, utility_context=None):
    """Retain the pre-backup selection before the archive's publication window.

    Its immutable generation survives a lost outer receiving checkpoint.
    A later recipient may keep editing its own received Workspace; those edits
    are not substituted into this original archived science binding.
    """
    scope = {
        "project_id": workspace.project["id"], "geographic_edition_id": prepared["id"],
        "ensemble_id": prepared["ensemble_id"], "scientific_source_id": scientific["id"],
        "delivery_id": delivery["id"], "review_id": review["id"],
        "review_response_id": response_id,
        "archive_selection": _archive_selection(archive_selection, handover),
        "handover_id": handover["id"] if handover is not None else None,
        "utility_context_id": utility_context["id"] if utility_context is not None else None,
    }
    path = Path(output) / "archive-bindings" / (digest(scope) + ".json")
    if path.exists():
        selected = read_json(path)
        _require(selected.get("id") == digest({k: v for k, v in selected.items() if k != "id"})
                 and selected.get("project", {}).get("id") == scope["project_id"]
                 and all(selected.get(key) == value for key, value in scope.items()
                         if key != "project_id"),
                 "Saved geographic archive binding differs from the selected original edition")
        return selected
    selected = binding(workspace, prepared, scientific, delivery, review, response_id,
                       archive_selection=archive_selection, handover=handover,
                       utility_context=utility_context)
    atomic_json(path, selected, immutable=True)
    return selected

def verify_archive(path, selected, previous=None):
    """Verify one opened archive and its exact selected original member closure."""
    path = Path(path)
    _require(selected.get("id") == digest({k: v for k, v in selected.items() if k != "id"}),
             "Selected geographic handover binding changed")
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        before = portable._archive_identity(stream)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(stream) as archive:
            manifest = portable._inspect_archive(archive, verify=True)
        checksum = portable._archive_digest(stream, before)
        current = path.lstat()
        _require(stat.S_ISREG(current.st_mode)
                 and (current.st_dev, current.st_ino, current.st_size,
                      current.st_mtime_ns, current.st_ctime_ns) == before,
                 "Geographic archive pathname changed during verification")
    _require(manifest["project"] == selected["project"]
             and manifest.get("selection") == selected["archive_selection"]
             and manifest.get("delivery") == selected.get("archive_delivery"),
             "Select the original complete geographic Workspace archive")
    for name, expected in selected["members"].items():
        actual = manifest["members"].get(name)
        _require(isinstance(actual, dict)
                 and all(actual.get(key) == expected[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")),
                 "Archive omits or changes selected geographic science: " + name)
    if previous is not None:
        _require(previous.get("bytes") == before[2] and previous.get("sha256") == checksum
                 and previous.get("binding_id", selected["id"]) == selected["id"],
                 "Geographic archive differs from its original saved bytes")
    record = {"path": str(path), "bytes": before[2], "sha256": checksum,
              "binding_id": selected["id"]}
    return manifest, record

# Geographic native archive binding and continuation

This additive helper completes the current geographic receiver's one editable native archive. The existing producer, source intake, native parameter course, mapped delivery, customer review, A73C opening page, and C57E isolated received-application child retain ownership and identity.

## Current caller composition

Install `source_tools/geographic_archive.py` with the current cumulative receiving source. The accompanying JSON includes five exact guarded joins against C57E's 13,592-byte caller, SHA256 f922e8d9e72b6845e7232f2a21276910e296980b774196312684d66e96874704. These joins complement the current author-owned utility, START_HERE and deadline hooks; apply them while composing the complete caller, not as an independently runnable partial overlay.

Preserve 6A4E's two archive-edition corrections from receiver Git 6cfff41500d31be2caa363aa6efef7f8f16c9bf1. The full replacement archive block in this packet retains both the per-edition archive map and current selected pointer for fresh backup, lost outer checkpoint and verified existing archive. Preserve current shared scientific receiving helper Git c39a47f0316e01422c5671b818375670ca4baed6; the historical bank's older helper is not an upgrade source.

Use final `model/geographic_receiving_context.py` Git c6357ad9209cd4deb8907a4133945405264cbb20, merged in 36442c809fdc62f9c32bdf528652d9df6a001374. Its maintained source bank is `integration/geographic-receiving-context-source-178d-20261013.json`. Use A73C's `source_tools/geographic_headwaters_handover.py` and complete source bank Git ab3ef78f01e16bf84a267d755ca35bd109ef87a1. Carry their actual current base dependencies through the maintained component installer; do not downgrade newer shared files.

The sole current receiver composes these stages:

1. Continue the original admitted preparation and native ensemble under its existing lock and task. After native completion, call `utilities = phase("utility_comparisons", lambda: utility_context.prepare(workspace, prepared))`; retain the returned original context in the operation.
2. Build the existing ensemble scientific source. After its `delivery_selection`, call `utility_context.append_sources(selected, utilities)`. Append every `utility_context.source_collection_ids(utilities)` to the original review's source collections, preserving the existing ordered sources.
3. Complete the original mapped delivery and customer response-generation export. Call A73C's `handover = phase("handover", lambda: prepare_handover(workspace, output, state, prepared, scientific, delivery, exported))`, then retain it in the same operation.
4. Apply the exact archive block from this packet. It retains a semantic binding before backup, includes all original intermediates and deliveries, and passes `delivery_root=handover["directory"]` plus `delivery_files=handover["files"]` to the same `portable.backup`. Do not pass mapped `delivery_state`: the opening-page handover and mapped delivery have distinct IDs.
5. Reuse `portable.resume_restore` for an existing received destination; preserve edits already made in that received project. Pass the returned original verified manifest to C57E's isolated cold child. In that child additionally call `geographic_receiving_context.inspect(reopened, utility_context_id)` and require its original prepared/baseline/alternative IDs to equal the selected retained context. The current caller must pass this captured context ID through its owned child request.
6. Keep the maintained `demo_deadline.cutoff_guard` at the original main-process boundary and `check_cutoff` before phases. Preserve original operation timestamps and elapsed histories.

## Exact archive semantics

`retain_binding(workspace, output, prepared, scientific, delivery, review, response_id, archive_selection=policy, handover=handover, utility_context=utilities)` writes an immutable binding under `output/archive-bindings` before archive creation. Its scope includes the original project/geographic/ensemble/scientific/mapped/customer generation, explicit archive policy, utility context and offline handover ID. Current full policy is `{"include_intermediates": true, "include_deliveries": true}`. Older archive generations retain their original policy and path.

The binding retains every original ensemble member's native run/artifact selection, grid/profile/scenario/source records and CAS companions, geographic input receipt, scientific source files, original utility plans/analyses/report files, customer response prefix, and exact native opening-page/review files. Actual runtime `*.lock` members omitted by the maintained portable writer are recorded as such while the unchanged input receipt stays retained.

`verify_archive(path, binding, previous=None)` invokes the existing complete portable verifier and archive digest through one opened file, checks its final pathname identity, original project, exact requested policy, optional delivery descriptor, and every selected member. An existing saved byte/hash/binding descriptor is preserved. Fresh and recovered archives follow this same path. A missing completed archive is not silently rebuilt under its old descriptor.

The one archive now carries `delivery/START_HERE.html`, its complete customer-review assets and the full original editable `application`/`workspace` layout. An opening-page or utility source change produces a new explicit archive edition; it does not replace a previous archive or alter a completed native run.

## Adopt the completed original course without rerunning preparation

When a worker reaches its completed native handover boundary, install the final cumulative receiver and continue its existing command with `--report-only`, the same `--workspace`, exact original `--selection`, and original `--output`. Keep active preparation/native processes running their admitted sources; do not replace the command beneath them.

The guarded report-only join reads the immutable original admission, exact selection bytes, original receiving/prepared records, original Workspace preparation and every original ensemble run. It requires completed native records, preserves the original operation/source identity, and records the current handover receiver separately. It skips `geographic.prepare`; the existing course is inspected with `execute=False`. It does not weaken admission for new inputs or run an alternate native job.

First actual exceptions and completion output return to the existing geographic production thread and operation. Preserve the original owner and accepted execution. The code and exact source contracts have been independently reviewed; local compile dispatch encountered an offline runtime before process creation. The equipped producer must execute its complete composed caller and inspect the actual resulting archive/application.

## Current owner direction and final recipient use

The complete current instruction follows unchanged. The producing worker must open the exact populated application and every delivered attachment, actually see/use it, and repair defects before calling the result ready. Open the scientific report, original maps and downloads, the exported archive's contents and the cold-restored working project; operate important controls. Retain the original 14:00 UTC cutoff.

"""Prepare and receive an actual-geography, simulated-input Upper Savannah case.

Preparation uses retained original geography and ordinary Workspace APIs.
--run continues the existing native parameter course and exports its real report.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from copy import deepcopy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

APP = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(APP) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(APP))

from model.common import atomic_bytes, atomic_json, describe_file, digest, file_digest, held, now, read_json
from model.workspace import Workspace
from model import geographic_headwaters as geographic
from source_tools.geographic_headwaters_reopen import cold_reopen, receiving_lock


def _outside(path, root):
    if path.is_relative_to(root) or root.is_relative_to(path):
        raise ValueError("Keep receiving output separate from the application and Workspace")


def receive(args):
    workspace = Workspace(args.workspace.resolve(), create=True, title="Upper Savannah geographic demonstration")
    # Source intake is explicit; paths name original ordinary Workspace manifests.
    for manifest in args.import_sources:
        with held(workspace.root/".workspace.lock", blocking=False):
            workspace.import_sources(manifest.resolve(strict=True))
    if args.catalog:
        return geographic.catalog(workspace)
    if args.selection is None:
        raise ValueError("Supply --selection, or inspect the actual --catalog first")
    source_bytes = args.selection.resolve(strict=True).read_bytes()
    selection = geographic.normalize(json.loads(source_bytes))
    if args.preview:
        return geographic.preview(workspace, selection)
    output = args.output.resolve()
    _outside(output, workspace.root.resolve())
    _outside(output, APP)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with receiving_lock(output/".geographic-receiving.lock") as receiving_lock_fd:
        original_selection = output/"original-selection.json"
        atomic_bytes(original_selection, source_bytes, immutable=True)
        admission = {"schema":"upstate.geographic-headwaters-receiving/v1",
                     "project_id":workspace.project["id"],"selection":selection,
                     "selection_bytes_sha256":hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest(),
                     "implementation_sha256":file_digest(APP/"model/geographic_headwaters.py"),
                     "receiver_sha256":file_digest(Path(__file__))}
        operation_id = digest(admission)
        atomic_json(output/"admission.json", {"id":operation_id,**admission}, immutable=True)
        path = output/"receiving.json"
        state = read_json(path) if path.exists() else {
            "schema":admission["schema"],"operation_id":operation_id,
            "project_id":workspace.project["id"],"created_at":now(),"stages":{}}
        if state["operation_id"] != operation_id:
            raise ValueError("Resume the original source/receiver edition in this directory")
        def save(**values):
            state.update(values,updated_at=now())
            atomic_json(path,state)
        def phase(name, action):
            started = time.perf_counter()
            save(active_stage=name,state="running")
            print(json.dumps({"operation_id":operation_id,"stage":name,"state":"running"}),flush=True)
            try:
                result = action()
            except BaseException as error:
                try:
                    save(state="interrupted" if not isinstance(error,Exception) else "failed",
                         error={"type":type(error).__name__,"message":str(error),"stage":name})
                except Exception as receipt_error:
                    if hasattr(error,"add_note"):
                        error.add_note("Receipt write failed: "+str(receipt_error))
                raise
            elapsed = time.perf_counter()-started
            previous = state["stages"].get(name,{})
            state["stages"][name] = {"state":"complete",
                "first_completed_at":previous.get("first_completed_at",now()),
                "first_elapsed_seconds":previous.get("first_elapsed_seconds",elapsed),
                "latest_elapsed_seconds":elapsed}
            state.pop("error",None)
            save()
            return result
        prepared = phase("prepare_geographic_inputs",lambda:geographic.prepare(workspace,selection))
        atomic_json(output/"prepared.json",prepared,immutable=True)
        save(prepared=prepared,geographic_edition_id=prepared["id"],
             ensemble_id=prepared["ensemble_id"])
        if not args.run and not args.report_only:
            save(state="prepared",active_stage=None)
            return state
        from source_tools.headwaters_parameter_course import continue_course
        course = phase("native_parameter_course",lambda:continue_course(
            workspace,prepared["ensemble_id"],execute=args.run,
            on_progress=lambda value:print(json.dumps({"native_progress":value},default=str),flush=True)))
        atomic_json(output/"parameter-course.json",course)
        save(parameter_course=course)
        if course["state"] != "complete":
            save(state="partial",active_stage=None)
            return state
        from model.ensemble_study_source import prepare as prepare_study_source
        from model.ensemble_scientific_source import delivery_selection
        scientific = phase("scientific_report",lambda:prepare_study_source(
            workspace,prepared["ensemble_id"],render=True))
        atomic_json(output/"scientific-source.json",scientific)
        if scientific.get("state") != "complete":
            raise ValueError("Continue the original ensemble scientific source until complete")
        selected = {
            "delivery_mode":"native_study","audit_scope":"source-native",
            "native_study":{"title":selection["title"],"purpose":selection["question"],
                            "reference":"geographic-edition:"+prepared["id"]},
            "baseline_run_id":prepared["baseline_run_id"],
            "scenario_run_ids":prepared["alternative_run_ids"],
            "contact":{"name":"Upper Savannah project team","organization":"Internal geographic demonstration","email":""},
            "source_roles":{},
            "overlays":{"drinking_water":{"source_collection_id":prepared["source_collection_id"],
                        "source_id":"GEOGRAPHIC_UTILITY_FOCUS",
                        "label":selection["utility_label"]+": original footprint within reporting area"}},
            "map_settings":{"weights":{"nitrogen_export":1,"phosphorus_export":1,"sediment_export":1}},
            "notes":["Actual geography; explicitly simulated terrain, forcing, land cover and source coefficients.",
                     "Upstream computational domain, South Carolina reporting area and utility focus are distinct.",
                     "Annual stream export is not concentration or intake delivery.",
                     "Restoration/control preserve actual class counts, area and recorded rainfall residuals."]}
        selected = delivery_selection(scientific["source"], selected)
        atomic_json(output/"delivery-selection.json",selected)
        delivery = phase("mapped_delivery",lambda:workspace.build_delivery(selected))
        if delivery.get("state") != "complete":
            raise ValueError("Complete the original mapped delivery before handover")
        save(scientific_source=scientific["source"],delivery_id=delivery["id"])
        atomic_json(output/"mapped-delivery.json",delivery)
        from model import reviews
        review_selection = {"schema":reviews.SELECTION_SCHEMA,
            "title":selection["title"]+": geography, assumptions and native results",
            "purpose":selection["question"],"source_collection_ids":[prepared["source_collection_id"],
                    scientific["source"]["source_collection_id"]],
            "run_ids":[prepared["baseline_run_id"],*prepared["alternative_run_ids"]],
            "delivery_ids":[delivery["id"]],"spatial_export_ids":[],
            "requirements":[
                {"id":"geography","title":"Review actual geography and scope",
                 "detail":"Check original HUC membership, upstream closure, South Carolina reporting intersection and separate utility footprint."},
                {"id":"assumptions","title":"Review simulated assumptions",
                 "detail":"Check assumed terrain, rainfall, erodibility, land cover, coefficients and treatment/control matching."},
                {"id":"native-results","title":"Review native support and annual export",
                 "detail":"Check original producing models, common finite cells, annual mass units and separate routing-support groups."}],
            "notes":["Scientific approval is recorded only through the actual returned reviewer response."]}
        review = phase("customer_review",lambda:reviews.create_review(
            workspace,review_selection,created_at=state["created_at"]))
        save(customer_review_id=review["id"])
        review_packet = reviews.show_review(workspace,review["id"],previews=False)
        response_id = review_packet["latest_response_id"]
        review_directory = output/"customer-review"/review["id"]/(response_id or "request")
        if review_directory.exists():
            exported = reviews.describe_export(review_directory)
            if (exported["review_id"] != review["id"] or
                    exported["project_id"] != workspace.project["id"] or
                    exported["latest_response_id"] != response_id):
                raise ValueError("Retained review export differs from the selected response generation")
        else:
            exported = phase("review_export",lambda:reviews.export_review(
                workspace,review["id"],review_directory,expected_response_id=response_id))
        save(review_export=exported)
        from model import portable
        edition = digest({"prepared":prepared["id"],"ensemble":prepared["ensemble_id"],
                          "scientific_source":scientific["id"],"delivery":delivery["id"],"review":review["id"],
                          "review_response_id":response_id})
        archive = output/("geographic-study-"+edition+".zip")
        archives = state.setdefault("archive_editions",{})
        if archives.get(edition):
            saved = archives[edition]
            if saved["sha256"] != file_digest(archive) or saved["bytes"] != archive.stat().st_size:
                raise ValueError("Retained geographic Study archive changed")
        elif archive.exists():
            manifest = portable.inspect_archive(archive,verify=True)
            if manifest["project"] != workspace.project:
                raise ValueError("Existing archive belongs to another original project")
            saved = {"path":str(archive),"sha256":file_digest(archive),"bytes":archive.stat().st_size}
            archives[edition]=saved
            save(archive=saved,archive_editions=archives)
        else:
            saved = phase("archive",lambda:portable.backup(workspace,archive,include_intermediates=False))
            save(archive=saved)
        received = output/"reopened"/edition
        if received.exists():
            restored = phase("resume_independent_restore",lambda:portable.resume_restore(
                archive,received,expected_archive_sha256=saved["sha256"]))
        else:
            received.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            restored = phase("independent_restore",lambda:portable.restore(archive,received))
        save(restored=restored)
        if (Path(restored["directory"]).resolve() != received.resolve()
                or restored["archive_sha256"] != saved["sha256"]
                or restored["project"] != workspace.project):
            raise ValueError("Independent receiving returned another original archive or project")
        manifest = portable.inspect_archive(archive, verify=False)
        cold = phase("independent_cold_reopen", lambda: cold_reopen(
            restored, manifest, prepared, scientific, delivery["id"], review["id"],
            output/"cold-reopen"/edition, receiving_lock_fd=receiving_lock_fd,
            receiving_lock_path=output/".geographic-receiving.lock"))
        save(state="complete", active_stage=None,
             completed_at=state.get("completed_at", now()), independent_reopen=cold)
        return state


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace",type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--import-sources",type=Path,action="append",default=[])
    parser.add_argument("--selection",type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output",type=Path)
    modes = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    modes.add_argument("--catalog",action="store_true")
    modes.add_argument("--preview",action="store_true")
    modes.add_argument("--prepare-only",action="store_true")
    modes.add_argument("--run",action="store_true")
    modes.add_argument("--report-only",action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not (args.catalog or args.preview) and args.output is None:
        parser.error("--output is required for preparation or receiving")
    result = receive(args)
    print(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False))
    return 2 if result.get("state") == "partial" else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
